name: ReCart frozen fixture evaluation
authoredBy: The ReCart builder (Claude Code acting for the team), from the declared catalog and recipe rules. Expected results were derived by hand; neither the solver nor the language model was run on these cases before freezing.
nature: Team-authored engineering fixtures on brand-free simulated products. Not an independent or real-user study.

versions.taxRule: 8% fixture tax, rounded half up to the cent

cases.text: My co-host and I record in my spare room, and we bring in one remote guest over Zoom each week. I work on a Windows laptop with USB-C. We already have two XLR cables. Keep it under $400 before tax. First session is Friday at 7 pm.
cases.referenceGoalNote: The buyer confirmed $432.00 all-in, which is $400 before the fixture's 8% tax.

expected.argument: The only in-stock loopback interfaces are IF-2B-LB and IF-4C-LB. IF-4C-LB makes the cheapest bundle $480.60, over $432. IF-2B-LB has a USB-B port, so it needs the USB-B to USB-A cable plus the USB-A to USB-C adapter: $396.36.

baseline.reason: Swapping only the interface keeps the USB-C cable: IF-2B-LB cannot connect, IF-4C-LB exceeds the budget, IF-2C-NL has no loopback, IF-2C-UK is out of stock.

cases.text: I host a one-person interview show. I'm in the room alone and my guest calls in on Google Meet. I use a MacBook Pro with USB-C ports, running macOS. My budget is $300 total including tax. We record Thursday at 9:30 in the morning.

expected.argument: The solo recipe only allows the USB mic, which is gone. The XLR remote recipe covers one person: the cheapest XLR mic, the USB-C loopback interface, an XLR cable and a USB-C cable, keeping the headphones and stand: $263.52. The USB-B route costs $308.88, over budget.

baseline.reason: The solo recipe's mic role allows only MIC-USB-D, so there is no item-only substitute.

cases.text: Two of us in the studio, plus one remote guest on Zoom. Our recording PC runs Windows and only has USB-A ports. We already have headphones and mic stands for both of us. Spend no more than $520 all-in. Sessions are Saturday afternoons at 2.

expected.argument: Only one MIC-DX-A remains and both people need the same mic. MIC-CX-C (phantom power is supplied by IF-2B-LB) and MIC-DX-B both work; MIC-CX-C is cheaper at the same disruption: $335.88.

baseline.reason: Swapping both mics to MIC-CX-C or MIC-DX-B passes every check.

cases.text: Me and a friend recording in my living room, no remote guests. USB-C MacBook Air on macOS. We'd prefer open-back headphones. Total budget $400. Recording Tuesday at 8pm.

expected.argument: No open-back headphones remain, so every bundle misses the soft preference. Closed-back headphones are a hard-valid swap: $344.52.

baseline.reason: Swapping the headphones to HP-CB-A passes every hard check; preferences are not hard checks.

cases.text: Two hosts in the room plus a remote guest joining through Zoom. We use a USB-C iMac with macOS. We'd like boom arms rather than desk stands. Max $500 including tax. We record next Friday at 6 pm.
cases.labelNote: Said on Monday Oct 12, "next Friday" can mean Oct 16 or Oct 23, so the date needs clarification.

expected.argument: Without a USB-C to USB-C cable no USB-C interface can reach the computer. The USB-B loopback interface with the USB-B to USB-A cable and the USB-C adapter works, keeping the boom arms: $443.88.

baseline.reason: Swapping only the cable to USB-B to USB-A cannot connect the USB-C interface.

cases.text: My co-host and I record in person; nobody calls in. Windows laptop, USB-C. We were planning on condenser mics. All-in budget is $380, but honestly we can't spend more than $350. Recording Wednesday at noon.
cases.labelNote: Two incompatible budget ceilings ($380 and $350) must be flagged, not silently resolved.

expected.argument: Keeping the condenser mics with the next interface (IF-2C-LB) costs $398.52, over $380. Only switching the mics to MIC-DX-A as well fits: $376.92. Every other combination is over budget or cannot connect.

baseline.reason: Swapping only the interface keeps the condenser mics: IF-2C-LB is over budget, IF-2B-LB cannot connect with the USB-C cable, IF-4C-LB is over budget, IF-2C-UK is out of stock.

cases.text: Just me, recording a solo show on my Windows desktop. It only has USB-A ports. Nobody else joins. I can spend $320 total. I want to start tomorrow at 10 am.

expected.argument: Open-back headphones replace the missing closed-back pair: $313.20, within $320.

baseline.reason: Swapping the headphones to HP-OB-B passes every check.

cases.text: I'm a solo host interviewing one guest over Google Meet from my USB-C MacBook running macOS. I already have good headphones. Keep the total under $150. Recording Thursday at 4:30 pm.

expected.argument: The boom arm replaces the missing desk stand: $112.32. Every XLR bundle costs more than $150.

baseline.reason: Swapping the stand to STD-BM-B passes every check.

cases.text: Two of us recording in the same room today at 3pm, no one remote. We have a USB-C laptop. Budget is $400 all in.
cases.referenceGoalNote: The buyer confirmed macOS. The first pickup window (10 am to 12 pm) ends before 3 pm.

expected.argument: MIC-CX-C (phantom power from IF-2C-NL) and MIC-DX-B both fit; MIC-CX-C is cheaper: $366.12.

baseline.reason: Swapping both mics to MIC-CX-C passes every check.

cases.text: Two people in the room and one remote guest. Windows laptop with USB-C. One of us already has headphones. All-in budget $460. We record Friday at 1 pm. Actually some weeks there are three of us in the room.
cases.labelNote: Two and three people in the room conflict; the call app is never named.
cases.referenceGoalNote: The buyer confirmed two people and Google Meet.

expected.argument: IF-4C-LB would cost $475.20, over $460. The USB-B loopback interface with its cable and adapter fits: $390.96.

baseline.reason: Interface-only swaps: IF-2B-LB cannot connect with the USB-C cable, IF-4C-LB is over budget, IF-2C-NL has no loopback, IF-2C-UK is out of stock.

cases.text: I record by myself in my office with one remote guest on Zoom. It's an older Mac with only USB-A ports, running macOS. First recording is Wednesday at 11 am.

expected.argument: The solo recipe needs a USB-C computer, so it does not apply. MIC-CX-C replaces the mic: $306.72.

baseline.reason: Swapping the mic to MIC-CX-C passes every check.

cases.text: Two of us, in-person only, no remote guests. USB-C MacBook on macOS. Up to $430 total. Recording Sunday.

expected.argument: Without a USB-C to USB-C cable only the USB-B interface can connect, through the USB-B to USB-A cable and the USB-C adapter: $422.28. Any costlier part pushes it over $430.

baseline.reason: Swapping only the cable cannot connect the USB-C interface.

cases.text: Me and my sister recording at home, nobody remote. My laptop has USB-C. $400 all-in. Tuesday at 6:30 pm.
cases.referenceGoalNote: The buyer confirmed Windows. One reserved headphone unit is missing but five others are on the shelf.

expected.argument: Other units of the same headphones are in stock, so the original bundle stands unchanged: $344.52.

baseline.reason: Another unit of HP-CB-A is available.

cases.text: Me plus my co-host in the room and a remote guest on Google Meet. Windows laptop, USB-C port. We both already have headphones. $480 total budget. Recording Monday the 19th at 9 am.

expected.argument: Both IF-4C-LB ($443.88, one changed part) and the USB-B route ($359.64, three new parts and two removed) fit. The declared ranking puts fewest changes before price, so IF-4C-LB ranks first.

baseline.reason: Swapping only the interface to IF-4C-LB passes every check.

cases.text: Solo show, just me, no remote guests. Windows desktop with USB-A only. Budget $300 total. Recording Thursday at 7 pm.

expected.argument: Only R-LOCAL-2 covers one person with no remote guest (the solo recipe needs a USB-C computer). A USB-A computer is reachable only through CBL-BA-1, whose device end is USB-B; the adapter only outputs USB-C. The only USB-B interface, IF-2B-LB, has none available. Every USB-C interface needs CBL-CC-1, which ends in USB-C. So every combination fails the connection or availability check.

baseline.reason: No other interface connects to a USB-A computer.

cases.text: Two hosts in the studio and one remote guest on Google Meet. USB-C Windows laptop. We already own two mic stands. Absolute max $385 including tax. Recording Saturday at 11 am.

expected.argument: Remote routing needs loopback; the in-stock loopback interfaces are IF-2B-LB and IF-4C-LB (IF-2C-LB missing, IF-2C-UK none in stock, IF-2C-NL has no loopback). With the cheapest part in every other role, IF-2B-LB with its cable and adapter totals $389.88 and IF-4C-LB totals $474.12, both over $385. The solo recipe does not cover two people.

baseline.reason: Every interface-only swap fails connection, routing, availability or budget.

cases.text: Two of us recording in my studio today at 1:30 pm, no remote guests. USB-C MacBook, macOS. Budget $400 all in.

expected.argument: At 10:30 am PDT the pickup policy (2-hour lead, slots at 10, 12, 2, 4 and 6) offers 2 to 4 pm first. Every bundle shares that window, which ends after the 1:30 pm deadline, so every combination fails the pickup check.

baseline.reason: The same pickup window applies to any swap.

cases.text: My co-host and I plus one remote guest via Zoom. Laptop with USB-C. $480 total. Friday at 10 am.

expected.argument: The documented loopback interfaces are all unavailable. IF-2C-UK is in stock and fits the budget ($366.12 with the cheapest parts), but its loopback is undocumented, so remote routing cannot be confirmed. ReCart must stop for evidence review rather than claim a fit.

baseline.reason: The IF-2C-UK swap has an unconfirmed routing check; the others fail.

cases.text: Just me in the room, interviewing a guest over Google Meet. MacBook with USB-C on macOS. Total budget $260. Recording this weekend at 2 pm.
cases.labelNote: "This weekend" can mean Saturday or Sunday.

expected.argument: The USB mic is gone, so only the XLR remote recipe applies. Its documented loopback options cost at least $263.52 (IF-2C-LB), over $260. The only bundle within budget whose known checks pass uses IF-2C-UK ($252.72), whose loopback is undocumented. ReCart must stop for evidence review.

baseline.reason: The solo recipe's mic role has no substitute.

cases.text: Three of us in the studio and one remote guest on Zoom. USB-C MacBook, macOS. $600 all-in. Recording Friday at 2 pm.

expected.argument: No declared recipe covers more than two people in the room.
